seasons.plot: A new love story unfolds when teen matchmaker Kitty reunites with her long-distance boyfriend at the same Seoul high school attended by her late mother.

seasons.plot: Kitty returns to Seoul ready for a fresh start, but her plan for a drama-free semester fizzles fast amid new faces, messy crushes and family secrets.

seasons.name: Stagione 3
seasons.plot: Kitty returns for her final year at KISS with her perfect senior year mapped out. She’s going to make meaningful memories with her friends, grow closer to her relatives in Korea, and make big decisions about her future. And, she’s going to define her relationship with Min Ho. For real this time. But when surprise revelations derail her plans and relationships, Kitty will have to learn to embrace the unexpected.

translations.overview: Mentre segue il suo cuore in un liceo esclusivo di Seoul, la giovane "cupido" Kitty scopre che vita, amore e famiglia sono aspetti molto più complicati di quanto immaginasse.

Teen matchmaker Kitty Song Covey thinks she knows everything there is to know about love. But when she moves halfway across the world to reunite with her long-distance boyfriend, she'll soon realise that relationships are a lot more complicated when it's your heart on the line.
translations.tagline: Time for some more Seoul searching.

overview.value: Kitty torna a Seul pronta a ricominciare, ma il suo piano di trascorrere un semestre tranquillo fallisce ben presto tra volti nuovi, cotte complicate e segreti di famiglia.
